title: These Cryptocurrencies Have Become Wall Street Favorites and Deserve a Place in Your Portfolio
author: Dominic Basulto
description: Bitcoin and Ethereum dominate Wall Street's cryptocurrency investments, with 12 and 6 of the top 20 spot crypto ETFs respectively. Bitcoin is praised as a unique portfolio diversifier with both risk-on and risk-off properties, while Ethereum leads in DeFi applications like asset tokenization and stablecoins. Other cryptocurrencies like Solana, XRP, and Zcash have spot ETFs but attract significantly less institutional capital.

title: Crypto Market Today, Sept. 8: Bitcoin Slides as Fed Hike Odds Pass 60%
author: Emma Newbery
description: Bitcoin fell 0.9% to $78,475 on September 8, 2026, as Federal Reserve rate hike odds exceeded 60% and a Liquid Network hack pressured sentiment. Ethereum showed resilience, declining only 0.1%, buoyed by the Ethereum Foundation's quantum readiness announcement and corporate buying. Solana fell 0.6% amid broader macro caution driven by rising oil prices and rate hike concerns.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The spot Bitcoin ETF saw positive inflows of over $117 million in net funds on Friday, indicating institutional investor interest despite near-term price weakness.

title: Got $1,000? Here Are 3 Cryptocurrencies to Buy Before the Midterm Elections.
author: Dominic Basulto
description: The article recommends three cryptocurrencies as potential investment opportunities ahead of the 2026 midterm elections: XRP, which could benefit from pro-crypto legislation; Bitcoin, which historically performs well in Q4; and Hyperliquid, which has gained regulatory support from the Trump administration. The author suggests allocating $600 to Bitcoin ETF, $200 to XRP ETF, and $200 to Hyperliquid ETF from a $1,000 investment.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Recommended as the primary vehicle for Bitcoin exposure, noted as the largest Bitcoin ETF by assets under management, providing convenient access to Bitcoin investment.

title: Crypto Market Today, Sept. 3: Bitcoin Reclaims $81,000 on Fed Rate Pause Signals
author: Emma Newbery
description: Bitcoin surged 5.5% to $81,491.82 on September 3, 2026, as Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled support for holding interest rates steady. Ethereum and Solana also gained over 5%, with the total crypto market cap rising 4.7% to $2.82 trillion. The rally reflects improved investor sentiment, though cryptocurrency remains vulnerable to macroeconomic factors including inflation, interest rates, and geopolitical tensions.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: IBIT led spot Bitcoin ETF inflows with $101.1 million in net inflows, indicating institutional investor confidence in Bitcoin exposure through this vehicle.

title: Nvidia Did the Heavy Lifting for the Major Market Indexes Today
author: Anders Bylund
description: Major market indexes rose modestly by 0.4% on Wednesday, with Nvidia and Meta Platforms driving nearly all gains. Nvidia jumped 3.8% to $225.67, single-handedly contributing 0.38% to the Nasdaq Composite's gain. Without these two stocks, the Nasdaq would be down and the S&P 500 would be nearly flat. Market moves were driven by macroeconomic factors, including New York Fed President John Williams' comments on Treasury yields reflecting a strong economy driven by AI and data center investment.
